eclass/arc-build: Make library dependencies available from target sysroot Currently prebuilt Android libraries, including their pkgconfig files and the pkg-config wrapper itself are located outside of the target sysroot. This poses a problem when using localy built libraries as dependencies of other packages is desired. This patch adds arc-build and arc-build-nyc ebuilds that install pkgconfig files, pkg-config wrapper and a symlink to the prebuilt binaries to /opt/google/containers/android, so that all the build prerequisites are available within the target sysroot. To resume the i2c device actively iff it supports runtime power managment. Once i2c devices support runtime power management, it might be in the auto power state which will put devices into suspend state based on defined policies. In this case, the touch updater might fail to access these i2c devices. This CL tries to change power/control from "auto" to "on" first iff a certain device support runtime power management. This is in order to wakup the device therefore touch-updater can interact with this device. Finally will set power/ control to it's orignial value once touch-updater finishes it job. BUG=chrome-os-partner:62754 TEST=maunuall perform chromeos-touch-update.conf and check the power/control in i2c devices are set to "on" not "auto". After updating procedure is done, check all power/control are set back to it's original value. install_toolchain: do not die if ${toolchain}/go is not installed. Having go installed as part of a toolchain was always optional. install_toolchain_in_provided() function has a check if $go_ver is empty, and only adds go to package.provided if it's not. Unfortunately, cross_get_version() was dying if go is not found. I've split cross_get_version() into two functions. The original cross_get_version() does not die if the package is not found. A new function cross_get_version_or_die() checks the results and dies if the package was not found. Checking go version uses cross_get_version(). Checking gcc/glibc version uses cross_get_version_or_die(). BUG=None TEST='setup_board --board=x86-zgb' works after disabling i686-pc-linux-gnu-go in cl/444042. Change-Id: Ice92e2c8a5a91ff474f2f3a35b8d6b2be0d92a5c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/444043 Commit-Ready: Rahul Chaudhry <rahulchaudhry@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rahul Chaudhry <rahulchaudhry@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Luis Lozano <llozano@chromium.org>
